Welcome to A Band of Biometricians, a professional forestry podcast where we explore the latest topics in forest biometrics, inventory, and growth & yield. In this first episode, I am joined by Dr. John Paul McTague and Dr. Corey Green to discuss the 2025 joint NEMO and SOMENS conference and to dive deep into the topic of Small Area Estimation --- ### A Band of Biometricians #2: The U.S. National Scale Volume and Biomass estimation system *September 03, 2026*
Watch on YouTube
Listen on Spotify
On this episode of A Band of Biometricians (a series from The Forester's Forecast), Micky Allen sits down with four of the people behind the USDA Forest Service's National-Scale Volume and Biomass (NSVB) system — Aaron Weiskittel (University of Maine), John Coulston (formerly USFS Southern Research Station, now NCASI), Jim Westfall (USFS Northern Research Station, lead author), and Phil Radtke (Virginia Tech). --- All episodes are also available on our [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TheForestersForecast-wb3jl) and [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/4fzgYVHRlYACdPJiM93L3C).
